enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up to chin. Place hand under pillow. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Adjust pillow position. Sneeze. Cough. Turn to right side. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Place arm over eyes. Turn to back. Lie still.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up, brushing teeth and getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Use toilet. Flush. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off tap. Wash face. Dry face. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open cabinet, take out bowl and cereal box, place on counter. Open refrigerator, take out milk, close refrigerator. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Open refrigerator, take out orange juice, close refrigerator. Pour juice into glass. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink juice. Stand up. Pick up bowl and glass. Walk to sink. Rinse bowl and glass. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and checking phone for the day's schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Close wardrobe. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Check calendar. Open email. Reply to message. Place phone in pocket. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the morning shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Hold bag. Look out window. Check phone. Reply to message. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk to hospital. Enter hospital.

enriched_activities.activity: Working a clinical health care shift, attending to patients and completing charting
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurses' station. Pick up patient list. Review charts. Walk to patient room 1. Knock and enter, greet patient. Check vital signs. Administer medication. Update chart. Walk to break room. Drink water. Eat snack. Return to nurses' station. Attend meeting. Update charts. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs. Walk out of hospital.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Bus stops. Stand up. Walk to door. Exit bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door. Take off shoes. Walk to kitchen.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator, take out pasta sauce, close refrigerator. Open cabinet, take out pot, place on stove. Turn on stove. Fill pot with water. Boil water. Add pasta. Stir. Drain pasta. Add sauce. Place pasta on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Stand up. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Rinse plate. Place in dishwasher. Turn off light and walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channels. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open shower. Step in. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Walk to washing machine. Open washing machine. Put dirty clothes in. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Start washing machine. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for leisure and light reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at computer. Turn on computer. Open browser. Read articles. Open email. Reply to message. Open social media. Scroll. Close browser. Pick up book. Read. Put down book. Pick up phone. Check messages. Turn off computer. Stand up. Walk out of living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, setting out clothes and preparing for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on light. Open wardrobe. Select clothes. Lay out clothes on chair. Open drawer. Take out pajamas. Close drawer. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Pick up phone. Set alarm. Place phone on nightstand. Turn off light. Lie down. Close eyes.

Lie in bed on back. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to right side. Bend knees. Pull blanket up. Place hand under pillow. Turn to left side. Stretch legs. Turn to back. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket down. Turn to left side. Place arm over eyes. Turn to back. Lie still.
